item.title: Heavy rainfall is expected over Middle-Shabelle, Hiran and Western parts of Galgadud
item.description: heavy rainfall of approximately 50 mm is expected over Hiraan, Middle Shabelle And Galgaduud regions, which may lead to flash flooding.

item.title: Thunderstorms with Heavy Rainfall Expected in Southern Somalia (Bay, Bakool, Lower & Middle Shabelle, Middle Jubba, Benadir)
item.description: Heavy rainfall accompanied by thunderstorms is expected across southern parts of Somalia, including Bay, Bakool, Lower Shabelle, Middle Shabelle, Middle Jubba, and Benadir regions. The rainfall may be moderate to heavy in some areas, with intense downpours occurring over short periods. These conditions increase the risk of flash flooding, particularly in low-lying areas, riverine zones, and urban locations with poor drainage. Strong winds and lightning associated with thunderstorms may also pose additional hazards, including damage to weak structures and risks to people and livestock. Communities in the affected areas are advised to closely monitor weather updates and prepare for possible impacts.
item.author: Forecast.section@moecc.gov.so (Somalia National Meteorogical Agency)
